notes.title: Update November 7, 2024
notes.notes:
Here's what you can expect from the new version:

 Storylines are available for the Sheep and the Dragons!  There are two ways to view these, either start a run at difficulty 1 and it will show the story for the character you're playing or go the the options (The gear icon in the top right) and select either the Dragon Story or the Sheep story.
 A new Sheep boss and a new Dragon boss!  These also come with new army units based on the bosses.
 We've revamped the mouse controls and made them better for touch screens.  The mouse controls should now behave much better and we've included options for both right and left handed play.
 And a few bug fixes.  (No one reported them so we won't list what we fixed...)

Thank you for playing!
